def process(pleasureBay) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    df = pleasureBay.copy()

    # Columns in this file (after skiprows=2) are:
    # Date, 1-Day Rain, 2-Day Rain, 3-Day Rain,
    # Tag + Enterococcus for three stations (Broadway, Flagpole, Castle Island Playground)
    date_col = "Date"
    rain1_col = "1-Day Rain"
    ent_col = "Enterococcus"  # Pleasure Bay @ Broadway

    sub = df[[date_col, rain1_col, ent_col]].copy()

    # Parse rainfall
    sub[rain1_col] = pd.to_numeric(sub[rain1_col].astype(str).str.strip(), errors="coerce")

    # Parse Enterococcus counts:
    # - Tag column holds '<' when the measurement is below detection; numeric value is in Enterococcus.
    sub[ent_col] = pd.to_numeric(sub[ent_col].astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r"^<\s*", "", regex=True), errors="coerce")

    failed = sub[ent_col] > 104

    out = pd.DataFrame([{
        "n_failed": int(failed.fillna(False).sum()),
        "avg_rain1_failed": float(sub.loc[failed, rain1_col].mean()),
    }])
    return out
